terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A giant public sculpture of a tilted glossy golden aerosol spray paint can mounted on a bevelled concrete skate-plaza plinth, a frozen arc of glossy magenta paint spray shooting out of its nozzle and splashing down onto the plinth. Photoreal studio product photograph of a premium toy-grade scale model, glossy automotive clearcoat paint, real rubber, brushed and chromed metal, real fabric, fine surface detail and light wear, saturated street-art colours. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
steps.note: billed in the timed-out generate.mjs run
